policy.stageOne: Resource payloads are owned at the scenario boundary: identified, preserved, referenced, previewed/played where supported, and replaced only through known-good encoders.
policy.stageTwo: Full PICT opcode, arbitrary cicn/icon-suite, snd command-variant, and custom music codec internals remain optional media-codec work.
